A block of mass $2.0 \text{kg}$ is on a plane which is inclined to the horizontal at an angle of $30^\circ$. The block is attached to a load of mass $M$ by a light, inextensible string which passes over a smooth pulley.
The load moves downwards at a constant speed.
A constant friction force of $5.0 \text{N}$ acts on the block while it moves.
(gravitational field strength $= 10 \text{Nkg}^{-1}$; assume that air resistance is negligible)
